rust.name: src/run.rs:276:5: replace hold_signals -> libc::sigset_t with Default::default()
rust.why: On macOS this skips blocking signals during spawn, while the signal tests wait for the child to start before sending one.

rust.name: src/run.rs:265:48: replace | with ^ in forward_signals
